up: For CHEMBL4857685 and all of its salt forms (molecule_hierarchy), retrieve all IC50 activities (standard_type = 'IC50') against the target CHEMBL240. Return the compound CHEMBL ID, the IC50 value with its units, and the activity relation. Do not filter by confidence score, document type, or relation.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation
FROM molecule_dictionary parent
JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = mh.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE
  parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4857685'
  AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL240'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
